notes:
POC is narrowly scoped to private VPC deployment inside EU region. Customer expects full Terraform modules + Helm overlay for release manager handoff. Key acceptance criteria: (1) successful Terraform apply in their account with state stored in customer S3 (or equivalent) and proper locking; (2) Helm deployment of redwood-runtime + metrics exporter + sidecar for keywatcher; (3) KMS envelope encryption verified end-to-end (Redwood uses CMK wrap, customer insists on using their HSM-backed key); (4) Splunk audit logging of request metadata + token-level cost sample; (5) routing policy configured so that heavy workloads route to dedicated pool and fallback to a smaller in-region model on saturation.

Shorthand notes from calls: "we cannot send raw PII out of eu accounts"; customer will provide transient service principal w/ least privilege. SE action: create runbook for rollback and version pinning (model and runtime). Customer prefers terraform v1.6+ and Helm 3.11.

Integration tests to run during POC: rollout canary (10 requests/min), KV cache warmup test, latency tail (p95 < 120ms for single-turn chat), throughput ramp to 200 rps, failure injection for model fallback. Document everything in drive link shared below.
additional_details: Model preference: open-models (llama-2-70b quantized or equivalent). Customer asked for a pre-baked quantized variant + fallback to a 13B 8-bit model for lower-cost requests. Expect to enable prefix caching for doc-search. Must include token-level billing export to customer's billing sink for cost reconciliation.
